question: What is the meaning of compositional elements in relation to product information?
description: The meaning of compositional elements in relation to product information refers to the detailed breakdown of the materials and substances that make up a product. This includes information on the percentage composition of raw materials, any hazardous substances present, the nature of recycled content, renewable materials, and any contaminants in the product. The compositional elements provide a clear understanding of what the product is made of and any relevant information regarding its composition.
